statements.subject: session
statements.description: It is the RECOMMENDED method to be used in a request sent for the sole purpose of updating the keep-alive timer. If this request is successful, i.e., a 200 OK response is received, then the keep-alive timer has been updated.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the receiver of the request is not supporting the media type used for the message body, it SHALL respond using the error code 415 (Unsupported Media Type).
statements.trigger: SET_PARAMETER received with unsupported media type in message body

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the server MUST only act on the request if all of the parameters can be set successfully. If the receiver of the request does not understand or cannot locate a parameter, error 451 (Parameter Not Understood) MUST be used.
statements.trigger: SET_PARAMETER received with unknown or unlocatable parameter

statements.subject: server
statements.description: When a parameter is not allowed to change, the error code is 458 (Parameter Is Read-Only).

statements.subject: session
statements.description: If the Session header is present in a request, the value of a parameter MUST be retrieved in the specified session context.
statements.guard_semantics: When Session header is present, parameter operation MUST occur within that session context
